bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
stage="deploy/state/startless-pr71-stage"
test -s "$stage/gaybbs.mjs"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = sha256:4d4ab3395ce4c250dc40ca179bbac7598d149288cac2381b54e11e7a719b6f5c
test "$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 stat -c '%u:%g' /app/gaybbs.mjs)" = "1000:1000"
test "$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 stat -c '%a' /app/gaybbs.mjs)" = "600"
test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local)" = sha256:4d4ab3395ce4c250dc40ca179bbac7598d149288cac2381b54e11e7a719b6f5c
test ! -e "$stage/Dockerfile.uid"
printf 'FROM gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:before-startless-pr71-20261122\nCOPY --chown=1000:1000 --chmod=600 gaybbs.mjs /app/gaybbs.mjs\nRUN test -r /app/gaybbs.mjs && node --check /app/gaybbs.mjs\n' > "$stage/Dockerfile.uid"
docker build --no-cache -q -t gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:startless-pr71-uid1000-20261122 -f "$stage/Dockerfile.uid" "$stage" >/dev/null
test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Config.User}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:startless-pr71-uid1000-20261122)" = node
test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:startless-pr71-uid1000-20261122)" != "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local)"
echo "STARTLESS_PATCHED_IMAGE_OWNER_AND_NODE_CHECK=PASS"
